transcript: Speaker A: Paytm mein sabki mummy teacher se sawal pooch rahi thi English mein. Main chup baithi thi. Teacher ne meri taraf dekha aur bola, "Any question?" Maine bola, "No, ma'am." Beta bagal mein baitha tha, woh samajh gaya. Mera naam Savitri hai. Main padhi-likhi nahi hoon, par apne bete ko maine best school mein dala, English medium. Sochi thi school padha dega, par PTM mein toh mujhe hi jana hai na. Teacher English mein bolti hai, "Your child needs to improve in reading." Mujhe samajh mein toh nahi aata par main sir hila deti hoon. Dusri mummy poochti hain, "Can you suggest some books on reading?" Mujhe bhi yahi poochhna hai, par English mein kaise bolu samajh mein nahi aata. Report card aata hai English mein, remarks aate hain English mein, grading system bhi English mein. A+ ka matlab pata hai, par "needs to improve" ka matlab mujhe pooch ke jaana padta hai. Ek din beta bola, "Mummy, agli PTM mein tum mat aana, papa ko bhej do." Maine poocha, "Kyun?" Chup ho gaya. Main samajh gayi, use sharm aati hai mujhse. Us raat phone par English Seekho app mila. Sab samjhaya tha usme. Padhna nahi hai, sirf video dekhna hai aur sunna hai. "General English" show kholo, "Hello se shuru karein" yeh pehla video tha. Aise roz ke 10 easy sentences seekhe. "My son is in class 3", "He is a good student", "He needs attention in reading". Aise chhote-chhote sentences par PTM ke liye kaafi. Good manners ke liye English words dekha, "Thank you, ma'am", "Excuse me", "I understand", "Could you please explain?". Teacher ke saamne bolne ke liye itna kaafi. AI coach se practice ki, 24 ghante available. Bola, "PTM hai kal, teacher se kya bolu?" AI coach ne sikha diya. Bolo, "Ma'am, how is my son doing in class? Is there anything I can help at home? He sometimes finds reading difficult. Can you suggest something?" 500 baar galat bola, usne 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi yeh nahi bola ki tum padhi-likhi nahi ho, tumse nahi hoga. Agli PTM mein gayi, teacher ne poocha, "So Mrs. Savitri, any questions?" Maine bola, "Yes, ma'am. How is Rohit doing in English? He tries to read at home but he struggles. Can you suggest some easy books for him?" Teacher ruki, smile kiya aur boli, "That's a great question. I'll send a list home." Beta paas mein baitha tha, woh meri taraf dekha, par is baar expression alag tha. Bola, "Mummy, tum next PTM mein bhi aana." English Seekho app download karo. "General English" show kholo. "Hello se shuru karein" se start karo. AI coach se practice karo. Apne bachhe ke liye seekho. Ek mahine mein PTM mein chup nahi baithogi. [At the PTM, all mothers were asking questions in English. I sat silently. The teacher asked me if I had questions, I said no. My son understood. My name is Savitri. I am not highly educated, but I put my son in an English medium school. I thought the school would teach him, but I have to attend PTMs. The teacher speaks in English, I just nod without understanding. Other mothers ask for book suggestions, I want to ask too but don't know how. My son once asked me not to come to the next PTM but send his father instead. I realized he was ashamed of me. That night, I found the English Seekho app. It explained everything simply through videos. I learned 10 easy sentences daily. I practiced with the AI coach who corrected me patiently. At the next PTM, I asked the teacher questions in fluent English. The teacher smiled and my son was proud, asking me to come to the next PTM too. Download the English Seekho app, start with General English, practice with the AI coach, and learn for your child.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [English Seekho. INSTALL NOW.]
summary: A mother shares her emotional journey of feeling embarrassed at her son's school PTM because she couldn't speak English, leading her son to feel ashamed of her. She downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily with video lessons and an AI coach, and successfully communicates with the teacher at the next meeting. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
